Itemized Passive Description:
*Basic effect(s)*
- Ki +2 and ATK & DEF 250%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Chance of performing a critical hit, chance of evading enemy's
attack & damage reduction rate 25%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Recovers HP with sweet treats
*When receiving an attack*
- Survives K.O. attacks (up to once within a turn)
*When attacking with 12 or more Ki*
- ATK & DEF 300%{passiveImg:up_g}
- ATK 250%{passiveImg:up_g} and interrupts the attacked enemy when there is
another "DAIMA", "Majin Power" or "Demonic Power" Category ally
attacking in the same turn
*For 1 turn from the character's entry turn, or when the character is
the 1st or 2nd attacker at the start of turn*
- ATK 300%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Foresees enemy's Super Attack
*For 6 turns from the character's entry turn*
- DEF 250%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Chance of performing a critical hit, chance of evading enemy's
attack & damage reduction rate 25%{passiveImg:up_g}
*When another 2 or more "DAIMA", "Majin Power" or "Demonic Power"
Category allies are on the team starting from the 4th turn from the
character's entry turn*
- {passiveImg:once}Changes Ki Spheres: All to cookies(*), TEQ & STR
(*excluding Ki Spheres with a Dragon Ball)
- {passiveImg:once}Ki +12
- {passiveImg:once}Chance of performing a critical hit & chance of evading
enemy's attack 25%{passiveImg:up_g}
- {passiveImg:once}ATK 800%{passiveImg:up_g} with 1 or more sweet treat Ki Spheres
obtained
- {passiveImg:once}{passiveImg:forever}ATK & DEF 250%{passiveImg:up_g} and chance of performing
a critical hit & chance of evading enemy's attack 25%{passiveImg:up_g} when the
character is the 1st to obtain Ki Spheres in a turn
